name: FractionalIdeal.isPrincipal.of_finite_maximals_of_inv
statement: Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] {S : Submonoid R} [IsLocalization S A] (hS : S ≤ R⁰) (hf : {I : Ideal R | I.IsMaximal}.Finite) (I I' : FractionalIdeal S A) (hinv : I * I' = 1) : Submodule.IsPrincipal (I : Submodule R A)

have_tree.name: coprime
have_tree.type: ∀ M ∈ s, ∀ M' ∈ s.erase M, M ⊔ M' = ⊤

have_tree.name: nle
have_tree.type: ∀ M ∈ s, ¬⨅ M' ∈ s.erase M, M' ≤ M
∀ M ∈ s, ∃ a ∈ I, ∃ b ∈ I', a * b ∉ IsLocalization.coeSubmodule A M

have_tree.name: hv
have_tree.body: Submodule.sum_mem _ fun M hM => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ <| hb M hM

have_tree.type: ∀ a ∈ I, ∀ b ∈ I', ∃ c, algebraMap R _ c = a * b

have_tree.name: hmem
have_tree.type: a M * v ∈ IsLocalization.coeSubmodule A M
